claims.statement: The H1 decline is primarily an availability loss in wholesaler-served dukas in Mwanza and Arusha following the distributor change, not a four-region demand or advertising problem

basis.reasoning: Losses are concentrated where and when distribution fell after the distributor switch; the proxy rate of sale where stocked is flat; the media cut was uniform across regions but losses were not; claimed purchase fell only in the affected regions.

confidence.reason: Several independent first-party signals align; sell-in and small survey bases limit precision

claims.limitations: Wholesaler destocking and local competitor activity not yet measured

hypotheses.proposition: Weaker advertising (lower weight or worn-out creative) caused the volume decline
hypotheses.basis: CEO brief; tracker ad recall fell 5 points
hypotheses.confirming_signal: Losses spread across regions and channels in line with the uniform media cut; consideration and claimed purchase falling everywhere
hypotheses.falsifier: Losses concentrated in specific channels and regions while the media cut was uniform; consideration stable
hypotheses.decision_impact: If true, a communications response would be justified; if false, a new campaign would not recover volume
hypotheses.validation_step: Compare volume and consideration by region against the uniform GRP cut; later, a regional weight test once availability is restored
hypotheses.review_condition: Revisit if volume in unaffected regions declines in H2 or if availability recovers without volume recovery

confidence.reason: Regional pattern contradicts it as the main driver; a smaller long-term effect of lower weight cannot be ruled out

hypotheses.proposition: The distributor transition reduced outlet availability in wholesaler-served dukas in Mwanza and Arusha, causing most of the decline
hypotheses.basis: Timing of distributor switch and audit results
hypotheses.confirming_signal: Losses concentrated in affected region-channels; distribution and out-of-stocks worsened there; rate of sale where stocked stable
hypotheses.falsifier: Distribution stable in affected groups, or rate of sale where stocked falling
hypotheses.decision_impact: Prioritise route-to-market repair over a new campaign
hypotheses.validation_step: Measure wholesaler fill rate and delivery frequency; track recovery against control groups after service fixes

confidence.reason: Consistent first-party evidence; mechanism link through delivery frequency rests on one email

hypotheses.proposition: A widening 500 ml price gap to the main competitor explains the small 500 ml declines outside the affected channels
hypotheses.confirming_signal: 500 ml declines larger where the gap widened most; 350 ml (no price change) stable
hypotheses.falsifier: No relationship between gap and 500 ml rate of sale; similar gaps in regions without decline
hypotheses.decision_impact: Could justify a 500 ml price or pack response later
hypotheses.validation_step: Price checks in all four regions and rate of sale by price-gap band

confidence.reason: Price data for Dar es Salaam only; effects small

hypotheses.proposition: Wholesaler destocking makes the sell-in decline in the affected groups larger than the outlet-level sales decline
hypotheses.basis: Sell-in data cannot show wholesaler inventory
hypotheses.confirming_signal: Wholesaler stock cover falling; outlet purchases from wholesalers declining less than sell-in
hypotheses.falsifier: Wholesaler stock cover stable or rising
hypotheses.decision_impact: Affects the size of expected recovery, not the direction of the recommendation
hypotheses.validation_step: Stock counts at the top 20 wholesalers in Mwanza and Arusha

confidence.reason: Outlet out-of-stocks rose, so destocking is unlikely to be the whole story, but its share is unknown

hypotheses.proposition: A category-wide decline in carbonated soft drinks explains the fall
hypotheses.confirming_signal: Declines across all regions and channels; competitor volumes also falling
hypotheses.falsifier: Most groups flat while a few collapse
hypotheses.decision_impact: Would redirect effort to category or portfolio responses
hypotheses.validation_step: Obtain category or competitor data if available

confidence.reason: No category data; within-company pattern argues against a broad decline

insights.decision: H2 2026 response to the volume decline
insights.audience_context: Wholesaler-served dukas in Mwanza and Arusha
insights.observation: Volume losses are concentrated in two region-channel groups that lost numeric distribution after a distributor change
insights.contrast: Affected groups versus all other region-channel groups; before versus after the January 2026 distributor switch
insights.mechanism: Less frequent deliveries left wholesalers and then dukas out of stock, so purchases were lost where the product was absent; where stocked, it sold at a similar rate
insights.explanation: Fizzi is not losing demand; it is losing shelves. The distributor transition removed the product from a fifth of wholesaler-served dukas in Mwanza and Arusha
alternatives: Wholesaler destocking exaggerates the sell-in decline (open, HYP-A04)
Unmeasured local competitor activity in Mwanza and Arusha
contradictions: Ad recall fell 5 points nationally, consistent with the media cut but not with the regional concentration of losses

confidence.reason: Several first-party signals align; proxy rate of sale and small survey bases limit precision

insights.implication: A new advertising campaign would not restore volume while the product is missing from these outlets
insights.validation_need: Wholesaler fill-rate and stock data; volume recovery versus control groups after service repair

options.title: Restore availability in wholesaler-served dukas in Mwanza and Arusha first; hold the new-campaign brief
options.diagnosis_addressed: Availability loss after the distributor transition (INS-A01)
options.where_to_act: Wholesaler channel and duka clusters in Mwanza and Arusha
options.how_to_win: Weekly delivery service from Distributor B, with temporary direct van sales if service does not recover

mechanism.explanation: Restoring numeric distribution to 2025 levels at an unchanged rate of sale would recover most of the lost volume

options.economics: Volume at stake roughly 266 thousand litres per half-year (about TZS 500 million net sales at H1 2026 prices); cost of service upgrade or van routes unknown and must be quoted
options.resources: Regional sales management time; possible distributor service fee or van-route costs
risks: Wholesaler destocking means sell-in recovers more slowly than outlet availability
non_choices: No new campaign creative in H2 2026 until availability recovers
No national price change on the basis of Dar es Salaam price checks alone
conditions: Delivery service route confirmed by week 6 (distributor agreement or van-sales bridge)
reversal_triggers: Availability restored to within 3 points of 2025 levels but volume still more than 10% below control groups: reopen the communications and category diagnosis
options.rationale: Addresses the constraint that explains 90% of the decline; reversible and fast to test

options.title: Brief a new advertising campaign now (CEO proposal)
options.how_to_win: New creative to lift recall and demand

mechanism.explanation: More memorable advertising increases brand retrieval and purchase

options.economics: unknown: agency and production costs not supplied
risks: Spends budget where product is unavailable
Does not address the diagnosed constraint
options.rationale: Evidence does not support advertising as the main cause; losses are regional and channel-specific while the media cut was uniform

options.title: Decide H2 media weight with a regional weight test after availability recovers
options.diagnosis_addressed: Possible longer-term effect of the 20% weight cut (HYP-A01 residual)
options.how_to_win: Evidence on whether restoring weight changes brand measures and volume

mechanism.explanation: If lower weight erodes brand retrieval over time, restoring it should protect future volume

options.economics: Cost of restoring 290 GRPs in the test region: unknown: rate card not supplied
options.resources: Media budget for the test region
risks: Test and control regions differ in size and trends
non_choices: No national weight restoration before the test reads
conditions: Restore 2025 weight in one region with stable availability and hold another as comparison for at least 12 weeks; compare consideration, claimed purchase and volume against pre-period trends
reversal_triggers: No difference between regions after 12 weeks
options.rationale: Media weight may matter for the long term even though it did not cause the H1 decline

options.title: Investigate the 500 ml price gap before any price move
options.how_to_win: Evidence-based decision on 500 ml price position

mechanism.explanation: If the gap suppresses rate of sale, narrowing it could recover volume at a margin cost

options.economics: unknown: margin impact depends on elasticity not yet estimated
options.resources: Field price checks (40 outlets per region)
risks: Delay if price is a real constraint
non_choices: No price change before the four-region read
conditions: Price checks in all four regions and rate of sale by price-gap band
reversal_triggers: Gap unrelated to rate of sale: close the question
options.rationale: Price evidence exists only for Dar es Salaam and effects are small

actions.description: Agree a weekly delivery service level (calls and fill-rate target) with Distributor B for Mwanza and Arusha wholesalers
actions.intended_change: Wholesalers receive weekly deliveries and stop running out
actions.mechanism: Restores wholesaler stock, enabling dukas to restock
actions.owner_role: Regional sales manager, Lake and Northern zones
actions.resource_basis: unknown: service upgrade cost not yet quoted
actions.reversal_trigger: No improvement in delivery frequency by week 6: activate ACT-A02

actions.description: Temporary direct van-sales cover for the top duka clusters in Mwanza and Arusha if weekly service is not in place by week 6
actions.resource_basis: Estimate from existing Dar es Salaam van-route costs; to be quantified before launch
actions.reversal_trigger: Route contribution negative after eight weeks

actions.description: Hold the new-campaign agency brief; keep current creative on air at the approved weight until availability recovers
actions.intended_change: Media budget not spent against unavailable product
actions.mechanism: Avoids wasted demand creation while the constraint is supply
actions.timing: H2 2026, reviewed at end of Q3
actions.reversal_trigger: Availability recovered but volume still more than 10% below control groups: reopen communications diagnosis

actions.description: Run 500 ml price checks in 40 dukas per region and analyse rate of sale by price-gap band
actions.mechanism: Discriminates between price and other explanations for 500 ml softness

metrics.definition: Numeric distribution and out-of-stock rate in wholesaler-served dukas, Mwanza and Arusha (field audit, 120 outlets each)
metrics.baseline: H1 2026: Mwanza 37% distribution, 34% out of stock; Arusha 38%, 31%
metrics.target_rationale: Return to within 3 points of H1 2025 (58% and 55%) by end of Q4 2026
metrics.decision_rule: Below 45% by end of Q3: escalate to van-sales cover or distributor change

metrics.definition: Distributor B delivery frequency and order fill rate to wholesalers
metrics.baseline: unknown: not currently measured; one report of fortnightly deliveries
metrics.target_rationale: Weekly deliveries; fill-rate target to be agreed in the service level
metrics.decision_rule: Weekly delivery not achieved by week 6: trigger ACT-A02

metrics.definition: Volume in affected groups (Mwanza and Arusha wholesaler-served dukas) versus control groups (Dodoma and Dar es Salaam wholesaler-served dukas), indexed to the same half of 2025
metrics.baseline: H1 2026 index: affected groups 66 (524/790); control groups 98 (628/640)
metrics.target_rationale: Affected-group index within 5 points of control groups by H1 2027
metrics.data_source: Company sales to trade; outlet sell-out if available
metrics.decision_rule: Availability restored but index gap above 10 points: reopen diagnosis

metrics.definition: Tracker consideration, ad recall and claimed past-4-week purchase by region
metrics.baseline: H1 2026: consideration 51%, ad recall 29%; claimed purchase Dar es Salaam 40%, Mwanza 29%, Arusha 30%
metrics.target_rationale: Consideration stable or rising; claimed purchase in Mwanza and Arusha returning towards 2025 levels as availability recovers
metrics.decision_rule: Consideration falls in regions with stable availability: prioritise the media weight test (OPT-A03)

metrics.definition: 500 ml shelf price gap to main competitor by region and 500 ml rate of sale by gap band
metrics.baseline: Dar es Salaam +9% (H1 2026); other regions unknown: not yet checked
metrics.target_rationale: Not a target metric; decision input
metrics.data_source: Field price checks and sales data
metrics.decision_rule: Clear rate-of-sale drop above a gap threshold: develop price-pack options; otherwise close

defects.claim_or_section: Diagnosis relies on sell-in volume (CLM-A01, CLM-A02)
defects.defect: Sell-in can differ from outlet sales when wholesaler stock changes
defects.evidence_or_missing_evidence: No sell-out or wholesaler stock data supplied; outlet audit and regional tracker purchase measures point the same way
defects.strategic_consequence: Size of the demand loss and speed of recovery could be misjudged
defects.required_fix: Bound the claim; add wholesaler stock counts (HYP-A04) and track outlet-level recovery

defects.claim_or_section: Rate of sale where stocked is flat (CLM-A04)
defects.defect: Proxy divides sell-in volume by a sampled distribution measure rather than measuring outlet rate of sale
defects.strategic_consequence: Could hide a demand decline among stocked outlets
defects.required_fix: State as low-confidence proxy; confirm with outlet sell-out from a sample of stocked dukas
defects.retest_condition: Outlet sell-out sample for stocked dukas in affected groups

defects.defect: Cost of distributor service upgrade or van routes unknown
defects.required_fix: Obtain quotes before committing beyond week 6; compare with volume at stake
defects.retest_condition: Quotes obtained and compared with contribution at stake
